recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
recipes.ingredients:
- 1 unbaked 9-inch pie crust (Wholly Wholesome brand)
- 2 eggs (Vital Farms brand )
- 1/2 cup coconut sugar (Big Tree Farms brand - it's organic + non-gmo )
- 1 & 1/2 tsp cinnamon (Simply Organic brand)
- 1/4 tsp nutmeg (Simply Organic brand)
- 1/4 tsp sea salt (Celtic Sea Salt brand since it's organic + non-gmo )
- 1 & 3/4 cups  
- 1 cup almond milk (MALK or Three Trees brand)
recipes.steps:
- Whisk eggs
- Add sugar, spices, and salt.
- Add pumpkin, almond milk. 
- Pour mixture into pie shell. 
- Bake at 375 degrees Fahrenheit for 55 minutes.

recipes.title: The Best Lasagna Ever
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef 
1 lb ground pork 
Large can of Raos marinara sauce
One box of lasagna pasta
Tablespoon of oregano
Half a chopped onion 
Carton of ricotta cheese
Fresh mozzarella cheese
Grated Parmesan
recipes.steps:
Cook the lasagna pasta in salty boiled water and put the pasta aside
Sauté the onions until translucent 
Add the ground beef and pork
Add the marinara sauce
Cook until bubbling then reduce heat to simmer
In a mixing bowl, combine ricotta cheese with egg, remaining 2 tablespoons parsley, and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
To assemble, spread 1 ½ cups of meat sauce in the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish. Arrange 6 noodles lengthwise over meat sauce, overlapping slightly. Spread with 1/2 of the ricotta cheese mixture. Top with 1/3 of the mozzarella cheese slices. Spoon 1 ½ cups meat sauce over mozzarella, and sprinkle with 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese.

Repeat layers, and top with remaining mozzarella and Parmesan cheese. Cover with foil: to prevent sticking, either spray foil with cooking spray or make sure the foil does not touch the cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for an additional 25 minutes.
Remove from oven and let rest for 15 minutes and then serve and enjoy!

recipes.title: Arayes
recipes.ingredients:
Meat mixture:
1 lb ground beef (85/15)
1 small yellow onion, grated and squeezed dry
5 garlic cloves, finely grated
1 grated jalapeño
2 tbsp tomato paste
1/3 cup parsley, finely chopped
1/4 cup cilantro, finely chopped
1 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp ice water
1 tsp salt
1 tsp black pepper
2 tsp cumin
2 tsp paprika
1 tsp allspice
1 tsp coriander
1 tsp garlic powder
1/4 tsp cinnamon
Other:
4 pitas, cut in half
Garlic tahini yogurt sauce:
3/4 cup Greek yogurt
1/4 cup tahini
3 garlic cloves, finely grated
juice of 1/2 lemon
1 tbsp olive oil
1/2 tsp salt
1/4 tsp cumin
2 tbsp parsley, finely chopped
2 tbsp cilantro, finely chopped
recipes.steps:
Preheat oven to 350°F.
Mix beef, onion, garlic, jalapeño, tomato paste, parsley, cilantro, olive oil, ice water, and spices until combined and slightly sticky.
Cut pitas in half, open pockets (microwave a few seconds first to ease opening), spread a thin layer of meat inside each, brush outside generously with olive oil.
Heat a pan over medium heat; cook arayes meat-side down 1-2 minutes until charred, then flip and cook each pita side until golden and crispy.
Finish in oven 15 minutes, until meat reaches 155°F internally.
Mix all sauce ingredients until smooth.
Brush hot arayes with olive oil mixed with minced garlic and parsley; serve with dipping sauce.
